summary.text: Jason Murillo is the Republican and Conservative Party nominee for the open NY Senate District 27 seat. A Lower East Side native known as "DJ Loud Mouth" in radio and media, he is listed by Ballotpedia as a politician/attorney. He ran for NYC Council District 2 in 2025 and lost the general election, and was listed as a withdrawn or disqualified candidate in the February 2026 special election for Assembly District 74.

paragraphs.text: Born in New York, NY; graduated from Seward Park High School.

Describes himself as a lifelong Lower East Side/East Village resident and, under the name "DJ Loudmouth," a media producer and radio host with about 20 years in television and radio, including programming on WPAT 930 AM, per his 2024 Ballotpedia survey. Ballotpedia lists his profession as politician/attorney.

Describes himself in that survey as a Manhattan Republican Party member, chair of the Manhattan Young Conservatives Club, a community board member, and a 74th Assembly District leader and leader of the Manhattan Conservative Party; the survey gives both current and former district leader titles.
Was the Republican and Conservative candidate for New York City Council District 2 in November 2025, losing to Harvey Epstein (D/WFP), 78.0% to 16.5%.

Was listed as a withdrawn or disqualified Republican/Conservative candidate in the February 3, 2026 special election for NY Assembly District 74, won by Keith Powers (D); he did not appear on that ballot.
Advanced to the general election for Senate District 27 after the June 23, 2026 Republican and Conservative primaries were canceled.
